newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack eyes bid for Underground-paper.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack eyes bid for Underground-paper.

text.p: UK rail operator Railtrack plans a takeover bid for the London Underground network if the Underground's track and signalling is privatised, The Times newspaper reported.

The paper said Railtrack's chairman Robert Horton has told UK government ministers that only a company of Railtrack's size could pay the one billion pound investment backlog needed to update the underground system.

The UK government has not yet decided how the underground network will be privatised but is expected to make an announcement before the UK general election, widely expected to be held on or before May 1 of this year.
Railtrack and London Underground currently share some sections of track around the capital.
